Built the anti-lobotomization gate as a DETERMINISTIC check: tools/heal_gate.py. Arm A (Efficacy): cosmic-ray-apply replay — earned kills must be real AND a no-regression sample of previously-killed mutants must stay killed (score must not drop). Arm B (anti-cheat, AST): bounces removed/weakened/assert-True/CUT-derived assertions. Proven complementary on 3 scenarios: heal PASSES both; a static `assert True` lobotomy is caught by Arm B; a SEMANTIC lobotomy (relax `==`->`in`, invisible to the static check) is caught by Arm A (7/8 of the heal's own kills evaporate).
